name: ai.midplane/midplane
title: Midplane
description: A gateway between AI agents and Postgres: table access, masking at the source, approvals and audit.

packageArguments.name: --config
packageArguments.description: Absolute path to midplane.yaml in local mode: each database's DSN and policy, and the key tokens are verified with (https://midplane.ai/docs/gateway/local-mode). Add the environment variables it names, such as a DSN or the mask salt, to this server's environment.

environmentVariables.name: MIDPLANE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A token from `midplane token`, verified at start and on every call. It stays in this entry, so give it a --ttl (seconds) as long as the entry should work: the default is an hour.
